messages.subject: Help with latent difference score model
parts:
Hello, everyone,

I am trying to check if latent variable scores change across two time points based on survey results before and after an intervention. I would like to use Lavaan to run the analysis. It seems that the model is called Latent Difference Score Model, which is similar but not identical to Latent Change Score Model. There are six latent variables and each has about 10 indicator variables (survey items). I don't know if Lavvan has programming language for this type of analysis since I have only two points of time (instead of multiple points of time). Any help would be greatly appreciated.
